hints.title: Sorted Price Array
hints.text: Sorting candy prices allows verifying whether any k candies can be chosen with minimum spacing d.

hints.title: Greedy Candy Selection
hints.text: To verify spacing d, pick the first candy, then repeatedly choose the next available candy whose price is at least d greater.

hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: If a spacing d is achievable, any smaller spacing is also achievable. Search for the maximum valid d.

hints.title: Binary Search Spacing Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting in O(n log n) followed by binary search iterations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all k-element combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond array sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the greedy selection condition over sorted prices with binary search.
